purpose: Governed national discovery for accessible warehouse, transport and logistics administration or coordination work. Manual warehouse labour, driving, management, sales, technical supply-chain and specialist procurement work are outside the proposed Ontap family.

boundary_notes.jobseeker_proposition: Practical office and systems-based work that keeps goods moving: warehouse and transport administration, logistics coordination, stock or inventory control, goods-in/despatch administration and routine import/export or shipping operations.
boundary_notes.likely_in: Warehouse, transport, logistics, distribution and supply-chain Administrators, Assistants, Clerks, Officers and Coordinators; Stock/Inventory Controllers or Administrators; Goods-In and Despatch Administrators; Shipping, Import and Export Administrators or Coordinators; and routine freight-forwarding operations support.
boundary_notes.advert_review: Generic operations, planning, materials, fulfilment, fleet, shipping and freight titles require evidence that the role is accessible day-to-day administration or coordination rather than manual work, management, sales, engineering, analytics or specialist compliance.
boundary_notes.out: Drivers, couriers, warehouse operatives, picker/packers, loaders, forklift roles and other manual work; managers, supervisors and team leaders; sales/account management; procurement and buyer careers; analysts, consultants, engineers and systems specialists; and senior or strategic supply-chain work.
boundary_notes.overlap: A genuine Warehouse & Logistics Operations job may also qualify for Service Admin, Customer Service or Finance / Accounts. Valid overlap is not a reason to remove it from this family.
